title: Flaky: test_expired_message_3_is_rejected_without_publication fails under full-suite timing pressure
description: Observed once during a full tests/coap run (b7z9.40(b) round): tests/coap/test_edhoc_responder.py::TestEdhocResource::test_expired_message_3_is_rejected_without_publication FAILED in the suite, then passed 6/6 in isolation and on a pristine-tree stash run. The test exercises message-3 expiry timing; under suite load the expiry window appears to race. Fix: inject a controllable clock (pattern already used by RawDiagTTL/RawTxResource) or widen the expiry margin so the assertion is timing-independent.
